description: Changes a plugin: name, settings (whole), patch (merged), form_html, status active or paused, or recipients {add: email}. A changed form or booking setup returns setup_summary and confirm_token first; a new inbox or an AI-set booking reply_to_email, approve_url.

confirm_token.description: After the person's yes to setup_summary, or for the approve_url status

lang.description: The page's <html lang>, e.g. de (one snippet per language)

patch.description: Merged onto the settings, e.g. {"approval":"always"}; null removes a key, arrays are replaced

recipients.description: {add: an extra inbox, for every site on the plan (needs Manage)}

settings.description: The whole settings object, shaped as list_plugins settings_help (forms too)

name: update_plugin
title: Change a plugin
